pages.text: These two modes handle 3D terrain: $(bold)Fill (FILL)$() is used for bridges, pits, and foundations; $(bold)Destroy (DESTROY)$() is used to remove wrongly paved blocks and flatten terrain.

$(li)Enter the mode: press $(bold)V$() → the $(bold)Roads$() icon → select $(bold)Fill (FILL)$() in the mode bar → double-click to pick a material.$(li)Pull out a 3D area: aim at the ground and $(bold)hold left-click and drag$() — a 3D bounding box preview is pulled from the start to the opposite corner, release to finish.$(li)Submit: press $(bold)Enter$(), and the area is filled with the chosen material.
pages.title: Fill (FILL)

pages.text: $(li)Switch to $(bold)Destroy (DESTROY)$() in the mode bar.$(li)$(bold)Left-click$() a reference block (e.g. a wrongly paved stone brick) to set it as the baseline height.$(li)$(bold)Hold left-click and drag$() to frame an area, press $(bold)Enter$(): blocks above the reference are broken, blocks below are filled up to the reference height, flattening the terrain.
pages.title: Destroy (DESTROY)

pages.text: $(bold)Filled something wrong and want to delete it?$() Switch to $(bold)Destroy$() mode, left-click a wrongly filled block as the reference, drag a box, and press Enter to clear it.$(br2)$(bold)Will Destroy remove buildings?$() It only processes blocks of the same type as the reference block within the framed area — just frame the right range.$(br2)$(l:wandscape:road/road_replace_guide)Replace Mode (Surface Paving)$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:road/road_guide)Road System Overview$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:contents/index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
